Method of Attack: Infects Linux-based IoT devices running stripped-down Linux on MIPS and ARM architectures by brute-forcing Telnet port
Installs SOCKS4 proxy to relay traffic from command and control servers
Used to create fake social media accounts, add fake followers and likes, and browse content to evade detection
Impacted Systems: Linux-based IoT devices on MIPS and ARM architectures
Attack Vector: Brute-force Telnet port on random IPv4 addresses
Indicators of Compromise: Use of SOCKS4 proxy on infected devices
Fake social media accounts on Instagram (1,732 accounts created in six months)
Suspended Instagram accounts (72% of created accounts)
Traffic relayed from infected embedded devices' IP addresses
